_ConnectionStrings_note: Password lives in User Secrets (dotnet user-secrets), NOT here. The full string (ConnectionStrings:Default) in User Secrets overrides this template at runtime in Development.
_Email_note: SECRETS LIVE OUTSIDE THIS FILE. Local dev: dotnet user-secrets (Email:User / Email:Password / Email:From). Deployment: environment variables Email__User / Email__Password / Email__From (double underscore = ':'). While User/Password are empty AND unset, the OTP is logged to the API console instead of emailed.
